query:
SELECT u.id as userId, mp.id as mentorProfileId, u.name, mp.university, mp.major, mp.grade
FROM users u
JOIN mentor_profiles mp ON u.id = mp.userId
WHERE u.name = '이윤호'
LIMIT 1;
